_note: The public-domain paintings in img/zen/, one record each. Pages read this file for captions and the home page's list of paintings; NOTICE repeats it. Every file was reduced for the web from the Wikimedia Commons file named in `commons`, whose page carries the licence template quoted in `licence`. Nothing is cropped: each image shows the whole work as Commons has it, inscriptions included.

works.title: Pine Trees (Shōrin-zu byōbu), right-hand screen
works.alt: Hasegawa Tōhaku's Pine Trees, the right-hand screen: pines in ink across six panels, some dark and near, most half lost in mist.

works.title: Portrait of Daruma
works.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (2015.500.9.3)
works.used_on: home page, "A mirror, never a command"
works.alt: Hakuin Ekaku's Daruma: Bodhidharma's face in a few washes of grey ink, eyes wide open, under a line of calligraphy, mounted as a hanging scroll.

works.title: Circle, Triangle, Square (○△□)
works.collection: Idemitsu Museum of Arts, Tokyo (the Commons page does not name it)
works.alt: Sengai Gibon's Circle, Triangle, Square: a square, a triangle and a circle in black ink, overlapping, with a column of calligraphy and a red seal at the left.

works.title: Six Persimmons
works.used_on: course: How the Translators Changed the Text
works.alt: Mu Qi's Six Persimmons: six persimmons on an empty ground, each in a different ink, from a pale outline to solid black.

works.title: Splashed-ink landscape (Haboku sansui), with the inscriptions above it
works.used_on: course: The Books of the Changes
works.alt: Sesshū's splashed-ink landscape: a small landscape of mist, rocks and a roof at the foot of a tall scroll, under long columns of handwritten inscriptions.
